body.title: Register the 'security.review' role in role-taxonomy.ts
body.summary: Add one new RoleDescriptor entry {id:'security.review', criticality:'critical', defaultTier:'core'} to the closed ROLES array in src/config/role-taxonomy.ts, so the role participates in coreFloor protection and is exposed by settings-catalog.ts like every other critical role. Pure data addition -- no accessor logic changes.
acceptanceChecks: roleDescriptor('security.review') returns the registered descriptor with criticality:'critical' and defaultTier:'core'
Every existing role-taxonomy.test.ts assertion (e.g. 'critical role must default to core') still passes for the new entry
settings-catalog.ts's generic 'every critical role appears' assertion covers the new entry without any settings-catalog.ts code change

tests.name: role-taxonomy.ts ROLES: the 'security.review' entry is criticality:'critical' with defaultTier:'core' (mirrors role-taxonomy.test.ts:49's existing 'critical role must default to core' assertion)
